title: Settings
description: Personal preferences (this browser) and shared server settings.

personal.scopeNote: These are stored in this browser only — they don't sync across browsers or devices, and don't affect other users.

language.title: Language
language.label: UI language
language.persistedHint: Saved to localStorage; takes effect immediately.

theme.title: Theme
theme.label: Color theme
theme.persistedHint: Saved to localStorage; takes effect immediately.

server.scopeNote: These are saved on the server and shared by everyone. Changes take effect for the whole deployment.

agentPrune.title: Long-offline agent cleanup
agentPrune.description: Automatically remove agents (PCs) that stopped sending heartbeats this long ago. Offline machines that come back reappear on their next heartbeat, so only genuinely-retired ones stay gone.
agentPrune.label: Prune after no heartbeat for
agentPrune.blankHint: Leave blank to use the default (shown faintly). With no default, blank means cleanup is off — long-offline agents are kept forever.

collectRetention.title: Collected-bundle retention
collectRetention.description: How long collected file bundles (from `collect:` jobs, shown on the Collect page) are kept before they auto-expire. Applied to the storage bucket immediately on save — no restart needed. Total disk stays capped regardless, so older bundles are also dropped once the bucket fills.
collectRetention.label: Keep bundles for
collectRetention.blankHint: Leave blank to use the default (shown faintly, currently 30 days). Extending this keeps bundles longer; the bucket's size cap still bounds total disk.

sessionTtl.title: Login session lifetime
sessionTtl.description: How long a SPA / CLI login stays valid before you have to sign in again. Applies to tokens minted after the change, not already-issued sessions. Disabling an account still takes effect immediately, regardless of this window.
sessionTtl.label: Expire login after
sessionTtl.blankHint: Leave blank to use the default (shown faintly, currently 24 hours). Allowed range is 1–8760 hours (up to 365 days).

controllerGroup.title: Controller group (trusted runners)
controllerGroup.description: The agent group whose members may run `tier: controller` jobs (e.g. a `feed:` job that fetches an external URL). These jobs are never dispatched to employee endpoints — only to members of this group.
controllerGroup.label: Controller group name
controllerGroup.blankHint: Leave blank and controller-tier jobs run nowhere (fail-safe) — the safe default so an external fetch never lands on an endpoint by accident.

mail.title: Email (SMTP) settings
mail.description: The outbound SMTP relay used for compliance-alert notifications and account setup links. Non-secret connection settings only.
mail.restartHint: Changes take effect after the backend restarts — the backend builds its mailer once at startup.
mail.usernamePlaceholder: leave blank for an unauthenticated relay
mail.passwordHint: The SMTP password is not set here — it's a server-side secret (the MailPassword registry value or the KANADE_MAIL_PASSWORD environment variable).
mail.blankHint: Fill in the host and from-address to enable email; clear them both to disable it (email becomes a no-op).
mail.invalid: Enter a host, a valid from-address (with @), and a port between 1 and 65535 — or clear the host and from-address to disable email.

restart.title: Restart backend
restart.description: Restart the backend service to apply settings that only take effect at startup (e.g. the mail relay). The API is unavailable for a few seconds while it comes back, and this page reloads automatically.
restart.confirmDescription: The backend service will restart and the API will be unavailable for a few seconds. In-flight requests may fail. This page reloads once it's back.
restart.toast: Backend is restarting — this page will reload shortly.
